id: PARETO: latency-noise and latency-accuracy trade-off over the whole tuning range of each estimator family (offline causal replay, ESTCMP3 logs: 55 runs, 30/50/70 N along x, y, xy, seeds 1140-1149)
registered: 2026-10-28, before any PARETO computation on these logs. Exploratory evidence (ESTCMP2 logs, 9 runs, not reused): IMU-SME below MOB at every latency, gap 2.2x at 100 ms to 7.8x at 35 ms

families.MOB: tuned momentum observer, all 29 torques, gain in {5, 10, 20, 30, 60, 120, 250} (other settings as ESTCMP2)
families.EMO: enhanced MOB + KF principle on the original observer, measurement noise r in {0.3, 1, 3, 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000} (other settings as ESTCMP2)
families.CIMU: centroidal + IMU, first-order filter K as IMU-SME (reported; no prediction)

metrics.latency: per setting: median over the 55 runs of the detection latency at the common rule (|d - d_slow(0.5 s)| > 25 N for 2 ticks); settings missing > 10 % of pushes are reported and excluded from the tests
metrics.noise: per setting: median over runs of the horizontal RMS deviation from its own mean in quiet stance before the push (1.0-2.95 s)
metrics.error: per setting: median over runs of the horizontal RMS error against the applied force in double support 3.0-3.5 s

predictions.D1 noise dominance: for every MOB and EMO setting, the IMU-SME noise interpolated (linear in log noise) at that setting's latency is lower; settings faster than every IMU-SME setting compare with the fastest IMU-SME setting
predictions.D2 widening: for both MOB and EMO, the noise ratio (family / IMU-SME at equal latency) at the fastest included setting with latency <= 40 ms exceeds the ratio at the slowest included setting with latency >= 90 ms
predictions.D3 error dominance: as D1 with the push error in place of the noise
